lead_raw_text:
The structure of CaAg3 crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3 (No. 143), with a unit cell containing 12 atoms—6 Ca and 6 Ag—distributed across two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows both Ag and Ca centers adopt a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors each, at neighbor distances of 2.8145–3.2552 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among 12-vertex Ag and Ca coordination polyhedra, though these relations are not exclusive to all polyhedra.
